integrity: Proof includes an exact local octahedron decomposition and a complete enumeration of the finite configuration space, with two independently specified integer algorithms and standalone code. No independent external validation or exhaustive bibliographic priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform nearest-neighbor zero-field classical antiferromagnet on the 24-cell graph only; the complete finite result does not extend automatically to nonzero field, random couplings, quantum dynamics, or thermodynamic limits. An unindexed graph-Ising table might affect historical priority.
title: Exact ground-state magnetization polynomial of the antiferromagnetic Ising model on the regular 24-cell
